summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Heinrich Gross, a German rabbi who also wrote as Henri Gross. It gives his birthplace and dates and notes that he studied rabbinical literature under Judah Aszod.
one_line: Heinrich Gross (1835-1910), a German rabbi born in Szenicz, studied rabbinical literature under Judah Aszod.
key_facts: Heinrich Gross wrote also under the name Henri Gross.
Heinrich Gross was born in Szenicz, Hungarian Kingdom.
Heinrich Gross was born on November 6, 1835.
Heinrich Gross was a German rabbi.
Heinrich Gross was a pupil in rabbinical literature of Judah Aszod.
